note: Traffic incident: shouts at a double-parker, a cut-off or a slow car (sim f9148be). context: double_park, cut_off, slow, horn_chain, bystander. Adults only.

lines.text: Hey! You double-parked! Move it or I move it for you!
You think you own the street? Two minutes, he says! It's been twenty!
Take your time, pal! I'll just live here now!
Where's the meter maid when you need her? Never! That's where!
You cut me off! Where'd you learn to drive, Jersey?
Signal! It's the stick by your hand! Use it!
Nice! Real nice! You almost put me in the hydrant!
It's green! Green! What are you waiting for, a letter?
Sunday driver on a Tuesday. Wonderful.
Lay off the horn! The horn don't make it move!
Everybody honk! That'll fix it! Brilliant!
Listen to 'em. Like a symphony, if the symphony hated each other.
Every summer. Heat makes everybody crazy.
Look at the cabbie. He's enjoying this.
